reason: The SpanFlusher docstring at src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/flusher.py:32 claims it 'Creates one process per shard', but the CLI option '--flusher-processes' defaults to 1 (src/sentry/consumers/__init__.py:432-437), so flusher.py:51,60-66 assigns all shards to a single process by default. Additionally, flusher.py:178 describes updating healthy_since for all shards when line 179 updates a single per-process Value, and flusher.py:235 says 'Check if any shard handled by this process is unhealthy' directly above 'cause = "hang"' after the elif at lines 231-234 already checked the single per-process timestamp.
